Hi Claire — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear ask. I’ve attached a concise runbook and an acceptance-criteria spreadsheet that maps each feature to test steps and sign-off owners. Summary of what I included (see attached):

1) SSO / SAML
- Required metadata exchange checklist (IdP SAML metadata, ACS URL, EntityID, certificate rotation window).
- Test cases: SP-initiated login, IdP-initiated login, SAML response attribute mapping check.

2) SCIM provisioning
- Initial attribute set (userName, givenName, familyName, emails, active, groups).
- Provisioning workflow: staged sync (create-only -> create+update) and conflict handling.
- Test cases: seed user, group sync, one attribute update roundtrip.

3) IP allowlists
- We included our recommended egress/ingress ranges and a CSV template you can drop into your firewall.

4) Service accounts & permissions
- Minimal RBAC for connectors, token rotation guidance, and HSM/KMS notes for keys if you require.

5) Rollback & cutover plan
- Quick rollback: switch IdP configuration back to your previous ACS and disable SCIM sync; we included timelines and escalation contacts.

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_runbook_v1.pdf, sso_scim_acceptance_criteria.xlsx, ip-allowlist-template.csv

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30-min kickoff this Thursday (10/14) to walk the runbook with your InfoSec and Network teams.
- Monica will propose a milestone timeline and own the coordination.
- We’ll validate test users in your staging tenant and provide a sign-off checklist by 11/05.

Monica / Marissa — pinging you to confirm the Thursday slot and add any implementation notes (especially around service-account creation and RBAC).

Best,
